CLIP (with atom IDs): E01.010 | 00:18.00-00:23.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Corin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E01.011 | 00:18.20-00:23.00 | ACT | Corin kneels on the slick quay boards.
E01.012 | 00:18.40-00:21.06 | DLG | SELENE (panicked, cruel) | "Mother will see you hang for this."
E01.013 | 00:21.50-00:23.00 | SFX | Glass shatters on stone.
E01.014 | 00:23.00-00:29.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Corin's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E01.015 | 00:23.40-00:27.96 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (urgent, kind) | "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
[Hard cut]
E03.021 | 00:42.00-00:47.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Selene and Mara, the space between them charged.
E03.022 | 00:45.50-00:47.00 | SFX | A heartbeat pulse rises toward the cliffhanger.
E03.023 | 00:47.00-00:52.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's hands gripping the rail.
E03.024 | 00:47.20-00:52.00 | ACT | Mara steps between Selene and the crowd.
E03.025 | 00:47.40-00:50.44 | DLG | CORIN (dry, earnest) | "I was drowned once. It did not take."
E03.026 | 00:52.00-00:58.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E03.027 | 00:52.40-00:55.82 | DLG | MARA (tender, quiet) | "My father built this tower with his own hands."
E03.028 | 00:58.00-01:03.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E03.029 | 00:58.20-01:03.00 | ACT | the Mayor throws open the shutters; the storm floods in.
E03.030 | 00:58.40-01:01.44 | DLG | SELENE (cruel, venomous) | "You think a scarred stranger can save you?"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
